text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy's offering to institutional investors will run from October 3 to October 22, the Ministry of Trade and Industry (KTM) said in a statement on Thursday.
The subscription period for the offering of Kemira shares to the public would run from October 23 to October 30, it said.
Kemira said earlier it will issue five million new shares and the Finnish state will sell 16 million Kemira shares to investors at home and abroad.
The subscription price, to be announced on October 23, will be the same for institutional investors and for the public, the ministry said.

The state will offer bonus shares to private investors so that an investor is entitled to receive one Kemira share free of charge from the state for each 10 shares purchased on condition the shares are kept for at least 12 months, it said. @
The state's holding in Kemira would fall to about 57 percent from the current 73 percent, the ministry said.
Goldman Sachs International will be international lead manager for the offering, and Merita Corporate Finance Oy will be the lead manager in the Nordic countries, the ministry said.
